Name: (CP) Maximalism - Beats and Bobs
Author: smallcopper
Description:
Hello! 

It's out, this one's for the music nerds out there. Thank you for all the love on my mods, it never stops being exciting to know people appreciate my semi-amateur pixel art. 

AT version will be out soon! Keep an eye out.

-

Install with Content Patcher as normal. These are all individual items so will not replace any vanilla textures. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35731]my catalogue[/url] for better organisation :)

I also highly recommend downloading [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14092]Furniture Placement Tweaks[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] for ease of use in decorating!

And check out the rest of the Maximalism series:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35737]Sorcery[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35730]Kitchenalia[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26106]Artist's Debris[/url]﻿﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿
[/list]

ALSO I now have a Kofi account set up, so if you're feeling really lovely, consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/smallcopper]buying me a coffee?[/url] :')
-

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44087]﻿Chinese translation[/url] now available! (thanks @dogfood233)

Thank you so much for downloading! Let me know if anything's buggy or ugly, and much love to all those who hate minimalism, as always :)

- A
